source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the water cycle and its Tidbits, printed pages 230-232.

blocks.text: Water cycle (hydrological cycle, paani ka chakkar) paani ki woh musalsal harkat hai jo abiotic hisson (hawa, mitti aur samandar) aur biotic (zinda) hisson ke darmiyan hoti rehti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Pakistan jaise mulk mein, jahan hamari zaraat (agriculture) aur maeeshat (economy) poori tarah Indus River ke nizam par chalti hai, water cycle sach-much qaum ki lifeline (zindagi ki dor) hai.

items: Evaporation (bhaap banna): Sooraj poore water cycle ko chalata hai. Sooraj ki shuaaein (solar radiation) samandaron aur jheelon ki satah ka paani garam karti hain aur paani ke molecules ko itni tawanai deti hain ke woh bhaap (vapors) ban kar urr jayen. Duniya bhar ki taqreeban 86% evaporation samandaron se hoti hai. Pakistan mein Arabian Sea bhaap ka sab se bara zariya hai; yahi bhaap aakhir kaar mulk ke andar tak pohanchti hai.

Condensation (bhaap ka wapas paani banna): Jab bhaap oopar atmosphere mein uthti hai to us ki garmi kam hoti jati hai. Jab hawa kaafi thandi ho jaye to bhaap wapas paani ke nanhe qatron ya barf ke zarron (ice crystals) mein badal jati hai. Yeh qatre hawa mein maujood gard ke zarron se chipak kar badal (clouds) banate hain.

Precipitation (barish ya barf girna): Jab badalon ke qatre bohat bhaari ho jate hain to gravity (kashish-e-saql) ki wajah se neeche girte hain. Darja hararat ke mutabiq paani barish, barf (snow) ya sleet (barf ya olon mili barish) ki shakal mein girta hai.
Infiltration aur Runoff: Zameen par girne ke baad paani chakkar poora karne ke liye do mein se ek raasta leta hai:

Infiltration (zameen mein jazb hona): Paani mitti mein reesta hai (percolation) aur neeche ja kar water table (zameen ke andar paani ki satah) tak pohanchta hai. Is tarah paani zameen ke neeche groundwater (zair-e-zameen paani) ki shakal mein jama ho jata hai.

Surface Runoff (satah par behna): Yeh zameen ki satah par paani ka khula behao hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab mitti mazeed paani jazb nahin kar sakti. Runoff ka paani naalon, daryaon aur aakhir kaar samandar mein ja milta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Pakistan mein surface runoff Indus River ko paani deta hai, jabke infiltration un zair-e-zameen zakheeron (aquifers) ko dobara bharti hai jin se hum peene ka paani lete hain.

items: Paani ka jandaron mein dakhil hona: Paani zyada tar do tareeqon se jandaron mein aata hai. Khushki ke paude root hairs (jarh ke baalon) se mitti ka paani jazb karte hain aur ise photosynthesis aur sahare (turgor pressure, cells ke phoole rehne ka dabao) ke liye istemal karte hain. Janwar meethe paani ke zariyon se seedha paani pee kar aur khuraak kha kar paani lete hain.

Paani ka jandaron se nikalna: Jandar ke andar apna kaam poora karne ke baad paani wapas be-jaan mahol mein chala jata hai. Paudon se paani nikalne ka sab se bara raasta transpiration hai: paude apne patton ke stomata (nanhe surakhon) se bhaap hawa mein chhorte hain. Paudon aur janwaron mein respiration se bhi paani ek zimni paidawar (byproduct) ke taur par banta hai; yeh "metabolic water" saans ke saath bhaap ban kar nikal jata hai. Excretion aur egestion mein janwar peshab aur fuzla (feces) ke zariye paani nikalte hain jo mitti ya paani mein wapas chala jata hai. Paseene (perspiration) mein janwar jild ke masaamon (skin pores) se paani nikalte hain jo bhaap ban kar hawa mein ur jata hai. Murda jismon ke galne sarne (decomposition) se bhi paani wapas mitti ya hawa mein chala jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do chakkar. Abiotic (Loop 1, neele teer): samandar, evaporation (suraj), atmosphere, condensation, precipitation (barish), surface runoff aur infiltration se mitti ka paani, phir wapas samandar. Biotic (Loop 2, sabz teer): mitti ka paani jarhon se paude mein, transpiration se hawa mein; paude aur barish se janwar ka ingestion aur jism; respiration se hawa mein, excretion se mitti mein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein 'Absorption by plant roots' ka teer ulta, mitti ke paani (soil water) ki taraf jata dikhaya gaya hai, aur Plant body-Ingestion aur Ingestion-Animal body ke teer dono taraf hain. Paani mitti se jarhon mein aur paude se janwar mein jata hai, is liye yahan teer sahi simt mein hain: soil water se absorption se plant body; plant body se ingestion se animal body.

blocks.prompt: Paudon se sab se zyada paani kis amal se hawa mein wapas jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Transpiration se, yaani patton ke stomata ke zariye bhaap ki shakal mein.

items: Abiotic loop: evaporation (86% samandaron se) → condensation (badal) → precipitation → infiltration (groundwater) ya surface runoff (darya, samandar).
Biotic loop: paude root hairs se aur janwar pee kar aur kha kar paani lete hain.
Paani transpiration (sab se zyada), respiration (metabolic water), excretion/egestion, paseene aur decomposition se wapas jata hai.
